'''Nyriaan spice''' was a type of [[Spice/Legends|spice]].

==Description==
Nyriaan spice was created by processing the [[mire nettle]], a type of weed that grew on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nyriaan/Legends|Nyriaan]]. It was a powerful narcotic stimulant and provided users with a euphoric experience. Nyriaan spice was marketed by [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] and the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidics]] in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner]] and [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], where it gained a foothold in the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] narcotic trade.
